description: Lists what the trainer's students paid or owe: amount, student, due date, paid date and status. Use status "overdue" for unpaid charges past their due date (oldest first, with days_overdue), "open" for everything not paid yet, "paid" for received payments. Pass student (part of the name) to see one student only. Totals are in BRL.

from.description: Due or paid on or after, YYYY-MM-DD.

student.description: Only this student: any words of the name, in any order ("souza ana"). Totals then cover just them.

to.description: Due or paid on or before, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: list_payments
title: See payments from my students
